_provenance: ORIGINAL CONTENT, NOT FROM THE RULEBOOK. The Broken Empires gives no table of common trades and no rules for pre-adventuring townsfolk; these tables exist so a funnel can generate a town's worth of ordinary people without hand-writing each one. It is written to fit the Baronies (Ch.20: shifting fiefdoms, fortified estates, river valleys) and to point at the book's own machinery rather than invent any. Nothing here is a mechanic: every skill name is a real catalogue skill and the numbers attached to them are assigned by the macro, not by this file. Treated the same way as data/concepts.json, which is the other original-content file in this repo.
_format: trades[]: range is an inclusive d100 span covering 1-100 exactly once. skills are real names from TBE.SKILL_GROUPS (funnel_check.mjs enforces this). kit is flavour text, not equipment Items. knows is the one piece of local knowledge that makes the person useful in a scene. stake is what they would run back into a burning town for -- the seed for the Bond and, if they live, for a Goal. bonds[] and scars[] are the funnel's own tables: a bond is the person a townsperson would break formation for, a scar is what surviving the night cost them. Both are prompts for play, not mechanics -- nothing in them touches a number.

trades.name: Tanner
trades.kit: Scraping knife, a rack of half-cured hides
trades.knows: which alleys drain to the river and which flood
trades.stake: The season's hides, which are all the family's money

trades.name: Cooper
trades.kit: Adze, iron hoops, a half-built barrel
trades.knows: every cellar in the quarter, because he delivered to them
trades.stake: A brother apprenticed across town

trades.name: Miller
trades.kit: Sack hook, dusting of flour that will not brush out
trades.knows: who in town is quietly in debt, and to whom
trades.stake: The mill, and the grain the town will need if it survives

trades.name: Miller's apprentice
trades.kit: A too-big apron, a sack needle
trades.knows: the roofline route from the mill to the market
trades.stake: Proving they are worth more than the sacks they carry

trades.name: Blacksmith
trades.kit: Hammer, tongs, a bar of good iron
trades.knows: which of the militia's blades are sound and which will fold
trades.stake: The forge, and the apprentices in it

trades.name: Smith's striker
trades.kit: Sledge, burn-scarred forearms
trades.knows: how long a fire takes to eat a timber wall
trades.stake: The smith, who took them in

trades.name: Farrier
trades.kit: Rasp, nippers, a pocket of nails
trades.knows: every horse in town by name and temper
trades.stake: The horses, which are the only way anyone leaves fast

trades.name: Carter
trades.kit: Whip, a cart with one bad wheel
trades.knows: the three roads out and what season closes each
trades.stake: The cart, and whoever can be loaded onto it

trades.name: Ferryman
trades.kit: Pole, a flat-bottomed punt
trades.knows: where the river is fordable and where it lies
trades.stake: The crossing, which is the town's only back door

trades.name: Fisher
trades.kit: Hand-lines, a gutting knife
trades.knows: the river's moods better than the priest knows his prayers
trades.stake: A boat that will hold four, maybe five

trades.name: Netmaker
trades.kit: Netting needle, coils of cord
trades.knows: who owes whom, from a lifetime of doorway gossip
trades.stake: A daughter who married into the north quarter

trades.name: Riverwarden
trades.kit: Boat hook, a short bow, a warden's brass token
trades.knows: the smugglers' landings nobody reports
trades.stake: The oath they took, which nobody else remembers

trades.name: Charcoal burner
trades.kit: Rake, a smell of smoke that never leaves
trades.knows: the woods, and every path through them that isn't a road
trades.stake: The burn, three days from ready and worth a winter

trades.name: Woodcutter
trades.kit: Felling axe, wedge and maul
trades.knows: which timbers in the palisade were cut green and rotten
trades.stake: An axe, and the arms to swing it all day

trades.name: Poacher
trades.kit: A bow that should not exist, snares
trades.knows: the ways under the wall the lord never found
trades.stake: Not hanging, which was already the plan

trades.name: Trapper
trades.kit: Line of iron traps, a skinning knife
trades.knows: how far a wounded thing runs before it stops
trades.stake: A dog, currently missing

trades.name: Herbalist
trades.kit: Satchel of dried stems, a mortar
trades.knows: what in the apothecary's stock is worth a life and what is chalk
trades.stake: The stock, which is worth more than the shop

trades.name: Midwife
trades.kit: Clean linen, a birthing stool's memory
trades.knows: every family's secret, having been present for the worst of them
trades.stake: The women she has not delivered yet

trades.name: Bone-setter
trades.kit: Splints, a leather strap for biting
trades.knows: how much pain a body can take before it quits
trades.stake: That nobody dies of something she could have set

trades.name: Priest
trades.kit: Vestments, a shrine key, a plain wooden token
trades.knows: what the shrine's crypt actually holds
trades.stake: The congregation, all of them, which is the problem

trades.name: Shrine-keeper
trades.kit: Broom, lamp oil, a chisel for the votive stones
trades.knows: which stones in the shrine floor lift
trades.stake: Something under the shrine nobody has asked about

trades.name: Hedge-witch
trades.kit: Charms of no proven worth, a good knife
trades.knows: what the old ways say about nights like this
trades.stake: A reputation that will get her blamed by dawn

trades.name: Scribe
trades.kit: Quill, ink cake, the town's only ledger
trades.knows: what the deeds say about who owns the river crossing
trades.stake: The records, which are the town's memory of itself

trades.name: Tax clerk
trades.kit: Tally sticks, a locked box, a list of names
trades.knows: exactly how much the town is worth to an attacker
trades.stake: The box, and what happens when they ask him to open it

trades.name: Reeve
trades.kit: Staff of office, a seal nobody outside town respects
trades.knows: which of the lord's promises were never written down
trades.stake: Authority that stops mattering the moment the gate falls

trades.name: Bailiff's man
trades.kit: Cudgel, a coat with the lord's badge
trades.knows: who in town already hates the badge he wears
trades.stake: Whether the badge is worth keeping on tonight

trades.name: Militia volunteer
trades.kit: Spear, a helmet that fits badly
trades.knows: the muster drill, run twice, badly
trades.stake: Not running, which is harder than it sounded

trades.name: Gate guard
trades.kit: Spear, a gate key on a thong
trades.knows: who came in this week and did not come out
trades.stake: The gate, and the decision about when to shut it

trades.name: Watch sergeant
trades.kit: Sword, a whistle, a list of the watch rota
trades.knows: which of his men will hold and which will bolt
trades.stake: Twelve people who will do what he says

trades.name: Bowyer
trades.kit: Staves, glue pot, a finished bow he has not sold
trades.knows: how many bows the town actually has, which is fewer than they think
trades.stake: The stave-stock, a year of drying wood

trades.name: Fletcher
trades.kit: Feathers, shafts, a fletching jig
trades.knows: how fast arrows run out
trades.stake: A sister on the wall who is going to need them

trades.name: Armourer's apprentice
trades.kit: Riveting hammer, a mail shirt with one panel finished
trades.knows: where the good armour is stored and who has the key
trades.stake: Finishing the shirt, which is stupid, and doing it anyway

trades.name: Stablehand
trades.kit: Halter, hoof pick, straw in the hair
trades.knows: which horses can be ridden bareback and which will kill you
trades.stake: The horses, all sixteen of them

trades.name: Drover
trades.kit: Goad, a dog whistle, road dust
trades.knows: the stock routes south into the badlands
trades.stake: A herd that is either salvation or a slow-moving target

trades.name: Shepherd
trades.kit: Crook, sling, a coat that smells of lanolin
trades.knows: the high ground and what can be seen from it
trades.stake: The flock, and the boy watching it outside the walls

trades.name: Swineherd
trades.kit: Switch, a bag of acorns
trades.knows: the drainage ditches, having chased pigs through all of them
trades.stake: A brother who thinks the pigs matter more than they do

trades.name: Beekeeper
trades.kit: Veil, smoker, hands that no longer flinch
trades.knows: how fire moves in a wind, from a lifetime of watching smoke
trades.stake: The hives, which cannot be carried

trades.name: Brewer
trades.kit: Mash paddle, a cask of the good stuff
trades.knows: which of the militia can be bought with a drink
trades.stake: The cellar, deep, stone-vaulted, and full

trades.name: Innkeeper
trades.kit: Cellar keys, a cudgel behind the bar
trades.knows: every stranger who came through in the last month
trades.stake: A common room currently full of frightened people

trades.name: Tavern server
trades.kit: Apron, a knife nobody knows about
trades.knows: what the soldiers said when they thought no one listened
trades.stake: Getting out with more than she came in with

trades.name: Baker
trades.kit: Peel, a stone oven's worth of heat
trades.knows: how many days the town can eat without the mill
trades.stake: The oven, and the queue outside it

trades.name: Butcher
trades.kit: Cleaver, hooks, an apron past saving
trades.knows: anatomy, which is a worse thing to know tonight
trades.stake: A daughter apprenticed to the herbalist

trades.name: Weaver
trades.kit: Shuttle, a half-finished bolt on the loom
trades.knows: whose cloth is whose, so whose body is whose
trades.stake: A loom that took a year to build

trades.name: Dyer
trades.kit: Vats, stained arms to the elbow
trades.knows: which of the town's water runs clean and which is fouled
trades.stake: The vats, which are also a hiding place

trades.name: Mason
trades.kit: Chisel, line and plumb
trades.knows: which walls will stand and which are facing over rubble
trades.stake: The wall he built, and what it means when it fails

trades.name: Thatcher
trades.kit: Reed knife, a long ladder
trades.knows: the rooftops as a road, because he works up there
trades.stake: A ladder that is suddenly the most useful thing in town

trades.name: Peddler
trades.kit: Pack of small goods, a scale that lies slightly
trades.knows: the price of everything, including passage out
trades.stake: A pack that is his whole life and slows him down

trades.name: Cutpurse
trades.kit: Two knives, someone else's purse
trades.knows: the roofs, cellars and gaps the watch never patrol
trades.stake: A fence who owes him, if the fence is still alive

trades.name: Beggar
trades.kit: Bowl, a bad leg that is sometimes real
trades.knows: who is kind and who only looks it, tested daily
trades.stake: A corner, a blanket, and one person who talks to him

trades.name: Refugee of the last war
trades.kit: Bundle, a child's shoe kept for no good reason
trades.knows: exactly how this goes, having survived it once
trades.stake: Not doing this again, and doing it again

bonds.relation: The one who took them in
Rival, and the only one who understands the work
Owes them money they cannot repay
They swore an oath to them once

scars.name: Burned
scars.line: Fire took skin off the face or an arm. It is the first thing anyone sees now.

scars.name: Crushed
scars.line: Something heavy came down. The leg or the hand never came all the way back.

scars.name: Shaken
scars.line: The night is still happening somewhere behind their eyes. Certain sounds put them back in it.

scars.name: Owes
scars.line: Someone else in the roster dragged them out. That is not a debt that gets settled.

scars.name: Bloodied
scars.line: They killed someone. First time. They know exactly how it felt and cannot say so.

scars.name: Abandoned
scars.line: They left someone behind, knowing. Nobody has said it aloud yet.

scars.name: Witness
scars.line: They saw what the attackers were actually looking for, and did not understand it.

scars.name: Wanted
scars.line: An officer saw their face clearly, in the middle of doing something unforgivable to him.

scars.name: Carried
scars.line: They got someone out on their back. Their own body paid for the distance.

scars.name: Struck the bargain
scars.line: They traded something away to get through a gate. It will be collected.
